01 — About

Business

I'm a freshman in my second semester studying Integrated Business Management at Dong-A University. Beyond business, I'm creative at heart.

I love watching fashion shows, sketching fashion pieces, and exploring different styles and silhouettes. I also enjoy drawing anime characters. For me, creativity is a way to turn ideas into something visual and personal.

01 / Fashion sketch

Tyla — Chanel Fall/Winter 2025–26

My sketch of Tyla’s Chanel look from the Fall/Winter 2025–26 show at Paris Fashion Week, presented at the Grand Palais on March 11, 2025. The look featured a pink Chanel tweed jacket, matching strapless top and mini skirt, styled with Chanel Fine Jewelry.

View the original look on Vogue ↗
02 / Fashion sketch

Imaan Hammam — Magda Butrym, Met Gala 2025

Inspired by Imaan Hammam’s custom white Magda Butrym look for the 2025 Met Gala, themed “Superfine: Tailoring Black Style.” The sculpted suit was finished with a black shirt, cane and feathered hat.

View the original look on Vogue ↗
03 / Fashion sketch

Rihanna — Marc Jacobs, Met Gala 2025

A sketch inspired by Rihanna’s custom Marc Jacobs look at the 2025 Met Gala: a black cropped wool jacket, bustier bodysuit, pinstripe tailored skirt, cravat and dramatic hat.

View the original look on Vogue ↗
04 / Fashion sketch

Gigi Hadid — Jacquemus Fall 2020 Menswear

Inspired by Gigi Hadid’s ivory, ruched dress from Jacquemus’s Fall 2020 menswear show in Paris on January 18, 2020. Vogue’s runway review notes Gigi and Bella Hadid walking the co-ed collection at La Défense.

View the original look on Vogue ↗
